# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library("grid")
library("upxdvir")
options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
```

## Draw UpTeX Content

```{r, fig.align = "center"}
grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
grid.segments(
    c(0, .5, .25, .75),
    c(.5, 0, 0, 0),
    c(1, .5, .25, .75),
    c(.5, 1, 1, 1),
    gp = gpar(lty = 3, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
)
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの\\textcolor{red}{ABCD}設定とし")
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", vjust = 1, x = .25)
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", vjust = 0, x = .75)
```

## Cleanup

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# TODO: This chunk needs to go away some time in the future.
system2("rm", paste0(Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE"), "/upxdvir/**/file*"))
system2("rm", paste0(Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE"), "/upxdvir/file*"))
```
